create_TensorboardWriter: create a TensorboardWriter instance to log training metrics and evaluation results to Tensorboard
add_scalars: add multiple scalar values to Tensorboard logs with a dictionary of tag-value pairs and a global step
plot_eval: plot confusion matrices and top-k prediction histograms for evaluation predictions and labels
add_video: add a video tensor to Tensorboard SummaryWriter for visualizing input frames with configurable fps
add_ndim_array: visualize n-dimensional tensors as 2D grid images with optional heatmaps in Tensorboard
